text:
Alice: Hey infra — we're spinning up a dedicated A100 inference account in eu-west-1. Need quota increases and a TGW + NAT design review. Account: 987654321098. Target go-live: 2026-05-15. Primary asks: p4d capacity, more EIPs for per-AZ NAT failover, and higher ENI limits. Who can own the AWS support case? :wave:

Ben: I got this. Quick clarifying Qs: single TGW with attachments or separate TGWs per VPC? Also are the VPC CIDRs locked?

Alice: Single TGW in eu-west-1. Three VPCs: prod/dev-test/inference. CIDRs (final): prod 10.10.0.0/16, dev-test 10.11.0.0/16, inference 10.12.0.0/16. We want per-AZ NAT with failover (hot standby).

Carla: We'll need two things: open EC2 quota increase cases with AWS and create an internal INFRA ticket for finance pre-approval. Ben — use the payload below for the AWS case to speed review.

Ben: Paste the payload here and I'll open the support case. Also tagging @Dmitri for ENI guidance.

Carla: ```
Account: 987654321098
Region: eu-west-1
Requests:
 - EC2 p4d (A100) On-Demand instances: 8 -> 40
 - Elastic IPs (EIP) limit: 5 -> 50
 - EC2 Network Interfaces (ENI) per region: 300 -> 900
 - Transit Gateway attachments guidance & quota for 3 VPC attachments
 - Interface endpoints count ~12 (ECR, SSM, CloudWatch, vendor model-registry PrivateLink)
Business justification: Production inference cluster with AZ-level HA and high throughput GPU jobs. Rollout: 2026-05-15. Contact: alice@redwood.com
```

Dmitri: AWS often wants expected instance counts and AZ distribution to validate ENI increases. Also check whether ENI quotas are per-AZ or regional for this account. Add TGW throughput/attachment questions if cross-AZ traffic will be heavy.

Ben: Updated numbers I put in the case: p4d 40 total (14/13/13 across AZs), NAT gateways per AZ 3 (primary + 2 standby) => initial EIP need ~9, ENIs ~20 per p4d for mgmt/monitoring/sidecars => ~800 total. Also requested Spot capacity (80) for autoscaling. Opening case now.

Raj: For PrivateLink: confirm whether vendor endpoints are in the marketplace partition. Some endpoint services require approval and service owner allowlisting. Add vendor account ID + service name to the request. Also request interface endpoint quota increases if needed.

Alice: Good call. Vendor registry PrivateLink added; endpoint count still ~12. Also need S3 gateway endpoints for control plane traffic and TGW route propagation to endpoints.

sre-oncall: Reminder on cost: per-AZ NAT + hot standby increases EIP and NAT processing charges. Rough NAT cost ~0.045 USD/hr each plus data processing. Flag finance.

Carla: Ben — when you open the AWS case request expedited review (business-critical) and CC our TAM. Use subject: "Limit increase: p4d + EIP + ENI + TGW guidance — acct 987654321098". After you get the AWS case ID I'll create INFRA ticket and attach the cost estimate.

Ben: Support case created: case-id 112233445566. AWS asked for a short architecture sketch and monthly spend estimate. Uploaded a diagram and a template, CC'd TAM.

infra-bot: Created internal ticket INFRA-2026-78 and linked AWS case 112233445566. Assigned to @Ben. :white_check_mark:

Alice: Diagram link for context: https://redwood-internal.s3.amazonaws.com/infra/diagrams/eu-west1-inference-tgw.png

Dmitri: Add a checklist to the AWS case: confirm ENI quotas per AZ vs region, confirm EIP per-region limits, confirm TGW max attachments and whether TGW Connect / acceleration is recommended for our throughput profile. Also ask about per-account limits on interface endpoints and if there's any soft quota for TGW route tables.

Ben: Added all the checklist items and asked for expedited review. AWS replied: "Escalated to EC2 limits team, ETA ~3 business days." I'll post updates in INFRA-2026-78.

Carla: Finance — please review INFRA-2026-78 for pre-approval and cost center tagging. cc: @finance-team

finance-bot: Finance review requested for INFRA-2026-78. Please provide expected monthly run-rate and cost center tag.

Alice: Estimated monthly run-rate for GPU infra at target utilization: ~USD 120k/month. Cost center: ML-Inference.

Ben: AWS closed the case with approvals: p4d -> 40, EIP -> 50, ENI -> 900 in eu-west-1. Note from AWS: "Transit Gateway attachment guidance provided; consider TGW Connect or TGW acceleration for heavy cross-VPC traffic." I'll update INFRA ticket and attach the AWS response.

infra-bot: INFRA-2026-78 updated: quotas approved. Next actions: finalize subnet sizing (Alice) and TGW route table + propagation review (Dmitri).

Alice: Copy. I'll schedule a 30-min sync with @Dmitri and @Ben tomorrow to finalize TGW route tables, NAT failover runbook, and subnet /20 sizing per AZ for GPU hosts. Thanks all. :rocket:
